categories.name: tests
categories.evidence: Carries the Tests label and modifies CI workflows and runner setup scripts to distribute qa-assets and fuzz corpora across test jobs.
categories.rationale: Fixes intermittent HTTP 504 gateway timeouts during asset downloads that cause spurious CI job failures before tests start. As stated in referenced issue #36814, redundant downloads across jobs fail intermittently, harming CI signal reliability and imposing a recurring burden on all contributors.
